item.title: Port St. Lucie residents oppose commercial rezoning near Tradition
item.description: A proposed land use change near Crosstown Parkway and SW Fairgreen Drive is heading to Port St. Lucie City Council for a final vote Monday after neighbors expressed concerns about how commercial development could impact their community.

item.title: World Cup semifinals set with England, Argentina, France and Spain advancing
item.description: England and Argentina won their quarterfinal matches over the weekend to complete the World Cup semifinal lineup. The four highest-ranked teams in the tournament will compete in the final four.

item.title: Jannik Sinner defeats Alexander Zverev to win second straight Wimbledon title
item.description: Top-ranked Jannik Sinner beat Alexander Zverev 6-7, 7-6, 6-3, 6-4 on Sunday to win his second consecutive Wimbledon championship and fifth Grand Slam title overall.

item.title: Linda Noskova wins Wimbledon women's title in all-Czech final
item.description: The 21-year-old Czech player Linda Noskova recovered from wasting five match points to defeat Karolina Muchova 6-2, 5-7, 6-3 on Saturday for her first Grand Slam trophy.

item.title: Florida Democrats claim path to breaking Republican supermajorities in state legislature
item.description: Florida Democratic Party leaders outlined a strategy Monday they say could break Republican supermajorities in the state legislature, pointing to more than 30 local and special-election flips since 2024.

item.title: Florida Democratic Party schedules Leadership Blue gathering at Disney resort
item.description: The Florida Democratic Party will hold its annual Leadership Blue gathering July 17 through 19 at Disney's Coronado Springs Resort in Lake Buena Vista, with former Transportation Secretary Pete Buttigieg delivering the keynote address.

item.title: Florida Democrats argue Republican property tax amendment could threaten local services
item.description: Florida Democratic Party Chair Nikki Fried said the party's candidates will challenge a Republican-backed property tax amendment, arguing that cutting local government revenue could threaten services or shift costs elsewhere.

item.title: Florida voters see connection between elections and home insurance costs, study shows
item.description: A study from Insurify found 71% of Florida respondents believe elections affect home insurance costs in their state, as insurance emerges as a key issue in the 2026 midterm cycle.

item.title: Florida insurance reforms linked to stable rates as more companies enter market
item.description: According to state leaders, reforms on insurance litigation have led to stable and in many cases lower rates, as more companies enter Florida adding to competition.

item.title: Florida Republicans hold voter registration advantage of more than 1.5 million
item.description: As of May 31, Florida had about 5.54 million active registered Republicans and 4.03 million Democrats, according to the state Division of Elections, with another 3.32 million voters registered without a party affiliation.

item.title: Jonathan Dickinson State Park concession closed indefinitely, boat rentals and tours unavailable
item.description: The concession operation at Jonathan Dickinson State Park is closed indefinitely after the vendor's contract expired, leaving visitors without access to boat rentals, canoe rentals, and the Loxahatchee Queen tour to Trapper Nelson's Island.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Opens Registration for Free City University Program
item.description:

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb to panoramic views
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, offers visitors a 105-step climb to panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, and Loxahatchee and Indian rivers.
